== Description ==
Annona cherimola is a fairly dense, fast-growing, woody, briefly deciduous but mostly evergreen, low-branched, spreading tree or shrub.”

s.d: Soursop is the fruit of Annona muricata, a broadleaf, flowering, evergreen tree. It is native to the tropical Americas and is widely propagated.

Nutmeg is the seed, or the ground spice derived from the seed, of several tree species of the genus Myristica; fragrant nutmeg or true nutmeg is a dark-leaved evergreen tree cultivated for two spices derived from its fruit: nutmeg, from its seed, and mace, from the seed covering. It is also a commercial source of nutmeg…
s.eq: “Nutmeg and mace, commonly used as food spices, have been used in folk medicine for their psychoactive properties, while their supposed aphrodisiac effects are not supported by clinical evidence.” beside “Psychoactivity and toxicity”
